listing.partnerModal.Aktion Mensch.headl: Inclusion is a matter close to our heart
listing.partnerModal.Aktion Mensch.text:
For us, the focus is on a self-determined life for people with disabilities and equal opportunities for children and young people.
Together with partners, we implement effective projects and develop activating campaigns and useful offers.
We inspire and recruit players for our lottery, which is what makes our commitment to inclusion possible.
listing.partnerModal.German Volunteers.t: German Volunteers was founded to promote volunteering and support organised sport. Team spirit is therefore part of our DNA. That's why we're always looking for partners with whom we share common goals and who want to advance our causes together.
listing.partnerModal.GoNature.headline: Become part of the solution
listing.partnerModal.GoNature.text: GoNature brings nature and species conservation projects together with people who want to help.
listing.partnerModal.GoVolunteer.text: GoVolunteer matches nonprofit projects with people who want to help.
listing.partnerModal.Voltastics.headline: Recognition for Volunteering
listing.partnerModal.Voltastics.text: We inspire companies and volunteers to network digitally in order to make voluntary commitment more visible and to organise mutual support better.
listing.partnerModal.headline: Our volunteering partners
listing.partnerModal.vostel.de.headline: We bring volunteers and non-profit-organisations together
listing.partnerModal.vostel.de.text: We envision a world where everyone contributes to a better, more sustainable future according to their abilities and regardless of how much time they have, what language they speak or what skills they bring with them.
